name: confessions
description: Anonymous confessions with numbered Components-v2 cards, optional threads, anonymous replies, and hash-based moderation that never exposes author identity.
endUserDataStatement: Stores cryptographic one-way hashes of author IDs per guild for moderation, plus your user ID linked to confessions/replies you author so reply notifications can reach you, and your notification opt-out choice. ID-linked rows are keyed to you and removed by GDPR deletion.
author: Antigravity
